notes: Redesigned the Review episodes dialog so the naming and destination controls are compact instead of oversized.
Moved Destination folder and existing-file handling onto the same compact row to free much more vertical space for the episode table.
Reduced episode editor and table row heights so more episodes are visible at once.
Combined disk-space and plan-status text into one compact status row.
Fixed the real cause of the Season selector clipping: local right padding was stacking with the combo-box drop-down width and hiding the second digit.
Removed the conflicting per-field padding and widened both Season selectors so values such as 02, 12 and 99 remain fully visible.
Made every Compare releases column sortable by clicking its header, with ascending/descending toggling.
Episode sorting now treats season packs specially: packs sort before episodes ascending and after episodes descending.
Fixed the Score column so Recommended is fully readable instead of appearing as an ellipsis.
Numeric columns such as Score, Seeders, Resolution and Size now sort numerically rather than alphabetically.
Fixed the Season range selectors so two-digit values such as 02 are fully visible instead of being clipped to a single digit.
Widened and rebalanced both season selectors to match the new unified field styling.
Removed the unnecessary vertical scrollbar from the empty Results state; scrolling now appears only when real result cards require it.
Rebuilt the Downloads action toolbar into two balanced rows so button labels and icons no longer crowd or clip each other.
Standardized Downloads toolbar icon sizing and minimum button widths for cleaner alignment.
Rebuilt the form-control styling so text fields, combo boxes, numeric fields and time fields use the exact same height, width behavior and 12 px corner radius.
Removed the separate square-looking spin/drop-down button backgrounds; arrows now sit inside the same rounded control instead of looking like an attached box.
Forced Settings form fields to expand to the same column width, eliminating random short and long controls.
Normalized button, list and table control radii across the secondary dialogs to the same UI language.
Added geometry tests that fail the build if the main Settings controls no longer share the same height and width.
